game.countries.long: Find countries on the map, or name the highlighted one. From the whole world down to a single region.
game.regions.long: The regions, states and provinces of every country: Morocco's 12 regions, US states, French departments…
game.flags.long: Name the country from its flag, or find a country's flag. Watch out for look-alike flags.
game.capitals.long: Find a country's capital, a capital's country, or place the capital on the map.
game.silhouettes.long: Only the country's shape is shown: recognize it, then find it on the map.
game.currencies.long: Which currency is used in each country? From the Moroccan dirham to the Japanese yen.
game.languages.long: A greeting appears: guess the language, or tap a country where it is spoken.
game.calc.long: Times tables, additions, subtractions and divisions. Easy to revise, hard for champions.

game.cinema.long: Who stars in Titanic? Who directed Jurassic Park? Which film features Jack Sparrow? Questions about great films, from Hollywood to Moroccan cinema.
q.cinema.actor: Who plays the lead role in this film?
q.cinema.year: What year did this film come out?
q.emoji.tale: Which tale is hiding behind these emojis?
q.emoji.series: Which TV series is hiding behind these emojis?
q.emoji.cartoon: Which cartoon is hiding behind these emojis?
q.emoji.character: Which famous character is hiding behind these emojis?
game.maroc.long: Morocco as we love it: cities, food, crafts, history, Darija expressions and great sites.
game.hello.long: “Shukran”, “Arigatō”, “Asante”… Thank you and goodbye in 18 languages, including Amazigh.
game.space.long: The planets, the Moon, the stars and the great space missions.
game.body.long: The heart, the brain, bones and senses: everything that keeps our body going.
game.dinos.long: Triceratops, T. rex, Morocco’s Spinosaurus… All about dinosaurs and their time.
game.vocab.long: 64 everyday words with emojis: fruit, animals, home, colours… Translate them into French (or into English for other languages).
game.roadsigns.long: The most common road signs and basic rules, to revise for a driving licence in Morocco.
game.sport.long: Football, tennis, rugby, basketball, Olympics, F1 and cycling: a mix of every discipline.
game.football.long: World Cup, AFCON, the Atlas Lions, great clubs and football legends.
game.tennis.long: Roland-Garros, Wimbledon, rules and great champions.
game.rugby.long: Scoring, rules, the All Blacks, the Springboks and the World Cup.
game.basketball.long: The rules, the NBA, the Dream Team and the big stars.
game.olympics.long: The Olympics, world records and Moroccan champions, from El Guerrouj to El Moutawakel.
game.motorsport.long: Formula 1, the Tour de France, Le Mans 24 Hours and the Dakar Rally.
game.daily.long: Every day, 10 questions from different games, identical for everyone. Only your first game counts in the daily ranking: share your score as coloured squares without giving away the answers.
game.pin: Drop your pin on the map
game.pin.long: A capital is named: drop your pin where you think it is. The closer you are, the more points you get; the distance is shown in kilometres.
game.flagreveal: The flag is revealed bit by bit
game.flagreveal.long: Tiles hide the flag and fall away one by one. Answer as early as you can: in multiplayer, the fastest score the most.
game.higher.long: Two countries head to head: which has more people, or the larger area? The figures are shown with the answer.
game.chain: A country starting with the last letter
game.chain.long: A country is given: type another one that starts with its last letter, in your language (Morocco → Oman…). Every valid answer counts.
game.timezones: What time is it in Tokyo?
game.timezones.long: It is noon in Paris: what time is it in New York, Tokyo or Dubai? Offsets are today's, daylight saving included.
game.sounds.long: Real recordings of animals: listen and find who makes the sound. Free sounds from Wikimedia Commons, author shown with the answer.
game.tables.long: A times-tables race: every right answer moves your car forward. Easy: the 2, 3, 4, 5 and 10 tables; hard: up to 12 and the missing factor.
game.timeline.long: Four events to put from oldest to newest: the pyramids, the French Revolution, the Moon landing, Moroccan independence…
game.stadiums.long: Real photos of famous stadiums, courts and circuits: find their name, the club or tournament played there, or their country. Free photos from Wikimedia Commons.
game.kits.long: A kit drawn in a club's or national team's colours: stripes, hoops, a band… can you name the team?
